mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_log (user_id, question, answer, source) VALUES (#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{source})
mapper.select: SELECT question FROM question_log WHERE question IS NOT NULL AND question <> '' GROUP BY question ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT question FROM question_log WHERE question IS NOT NULL AND question <> '' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, user_id, question, answer, source, created_at, processed FROM question_log WHERE processed = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE question_log SET processed = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_log WHERE DATE(created_at) = #{date}
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM question_log WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
SELECT source AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM question_log WHERE source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT question FROM question_log WHERE DATE(created_at) = #{date} AND question IS NOT NULL AND question <> ''
SELECT question FROM question_log WHERE DATE(created_at) = #{date} AND question IS NOT NULL AND question <> '' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT question, source, created_at FROM question_log WHERE question IS NOT NULL AND question <> '' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT question AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM question_log WHERE question IS NOT NULL AND question <> '' GROUP BY question ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT question AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM question_log WHERE question IS NOT NULL AND question <> '' AND DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY question ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
